rules.text: [seed 2026-10-18 tier-1 toolbox] Gidney 2018 temporary AND: a Toffoli PAIR that computes and later uncomputes the same AND costs 4 T total - 4 T to compute, 0 T to uncompute via X-basis measurement + classically controlled CZ fix-up. Clean pairs (target declared zero-init, |0> before, unwritten between) take temporary_and directly on the target; any pair with unchanged controls takes it via a fresh ancilla (via_ancilla: true) with cx(ancilla, target) at both ends.

[seed 2026-10-18 tier-1 toolbox] Jones Toffoli / measurement-based uncompute: ANY single ccx or ccz costs 4 T + 1 fresh clean ancilla + 1 measurement (jones_toffoli) - AND into the ancilla (4 T), cx/cz(ancilla, target), then measure the ancilla and fix up with Cliffords. Use it for unpaired Toffolis that have no clean target.

[seed 2026-10-18 tier-1 toolbox] Clean-AND compute-only: a Toffoli whose target is a declared zero-init qubit still |0> at that point is a pure AND - 4 T, no measurement, no uncompute (clean_and). Typical for the first write into an output register (multiplier-like accumulation).

[seed 2026-10-18 tier-1 toolbox] Relative-phase Toffoli pairing (Maslov RCCX): a mirror pair (same Toffoli repeated, target only READ in between) can use the 4-T relative-phase Toffoli on BOTH members - the second cancels the first's phase, so the pair is EXACT (8 T, unitary-preserving). Never use RCCX on a lone Toffoli: the uncancelled phase is an error.

[seed 2026-10-18 tier-1 routing lesson] Mirror pair writing into a declared-zero target => temporary-AND: when the recognizer shows a pair whose target is a declared zero-init qubit (class 'clean'), temporary_and on the target is strictly cheaper than any exact route (4 T vs 8+ T) and the relaxed verifier certifies it branch-wise. Route clean pairs FIRST; they are the highest-value decisions on adder-like structure.

[seed 2026-10-18 tier-1 toolbox] MCX cascades: an unpaired Toffoli whose controls are targets of enclosing pairs is a multi-controlled X built from an AND ladder. Relaxed: ancilla_mcx (every enclosing pair -> temporary_and, middle -> jones_toffoli, 4 T per element). Exact: barenco_mcx (pairs -> relative_phase_toffoli 8 T each, middle 7 T).

[seed 2026-10-18 literature harvest] Whole-adder pairing strategy: in a Cuccaro-style ripple adder ALL BUT ONE Toffoli appears in a compute/uncompute pair. Plan the WHOLE circuit before deciding any element: classify every Toffoli into pairs first, route every pair as temporary_and (4 T), and only the leftover unpaired Toffoli(s) as jones_toffoli (4 T) - this is what turns 7n naive T into 4n+O(1), not per-element greediness.

[seed 2026-10-18 literature harvest] Compute/uncompute asymmetry: computing a temporary AND costs 4 T but UNcomputing it costs 0 T (X-basis measurement + classically controlled CZ fixup - measurement is not reversible, use it). When a plan can choose which side of a pair carries the T cost, put it on the compute side; an out-of-place register that is later uncomputed is uncomputed for free under the relaxed contract.

[seed 2026-10-18 literature harvest] Ancilla-vs-T tradeoff for multi-controlled gates: best known k-control X is 4k-4 T using k-1 CLEAN ancillas (temporary-AND ladder); Barenco-style constructions save ancillas at a LARGE T increase. Fitness is lexicographic with T first: whenever declared-zero ancillas exist, take ancilla_mcx; reserve barenco_mcx for genuinely qubit-starved circuits.

[seed 2026-10-18 literature harvest] Floor awareness: a measurement-FREE compute/uncompute Toffoli block costs >= 8 T (isotropy lower bound); only measurement-based routes reach 4 T per pair. A relaxed plan at 4 T per paired element and 4 per unpaired (jones), or an exact plan at 8 per pair and 7 per unpaired, sits AT the known floor - further T proposals are wasted calls; propose qubit or T-depth improvements instead, or decline (NONE).

Floor check BEFORE proposing: relaxed lower bound = 4 T per compute/uncompute PAIR (not per element, since the uncompute is free) + 4 T per unpaired Toffoli. Exact bound = 8 per pair + 7 per unpaired. If the parent's t_count already equals that bound, answer NONE. Re-submitting the same plan is rejected as 'no improvement'.
